summary: Eco-discount offset appears on estimate but not on finalized multi-model invoice after async postback reordering
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that the eco/sustainability discount line appears in the Console estimate and in provisional invoice previews, but disappears from the finalized invoice for a multi-model job that ran across two regions. Impact: Customer sees a $3,120 gap between estimate and finalized invoice for March billing cycle and requests explanation and refund for missing eco discount. Environment: GreenByte Analytics production org (org_id: org_0GBY), private connectors to US-WEST and EU-WEST, mix of hosted fallback and private reserved hours on the day in question.

Observed behavior:
- Console cost estimate (snapshot taken 2026-03-09 15:22:11 UTC) showed eco-tier discount line (-$3,120) applied to the batch.
- Provisional invoice generated during reconciliation (2026-03-10 02:03:08 UTC) also showed discount.
- Finalized invoice (2026-03-11 05:14:06 UTC) does NOT include the eco discount line; total increased by $3,120.

Why this matters: Enterprise contract includes an eco-tier discount (5%) applied to qualifying model-hours; customer audits monthly invoices. Missing discount causes billing dispute and potential revenue recognition adjustments.

Attachments: Customer's screenshot of console estimate, copies of provisional + finalized invoice PDFs (customer-provided), sample usage postback payloads (anonymized).
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Create a multi-model batch job that spans us-west and eu-west using a mix of quantized and legacy variants.
2) Ensure the account has eco-tier eligibility flag set.
3) Let the job run during a fallback window that triggers async postback routing (simulate network delay > 15s to force reorder).
4) Trigger reconciliation flow and finalize invoice.
5) Compare provisional invoice lines to finalized invoice lines for eco discount application.

investigation_notes:
Initial hypotheses: (A) Async postback reordering caused discount tags to be applied after the reconciliation window and then overwritten during finalization. (B) The invoice-generator rate-selector cache was refreshed between provisional and finalize steps and dropped eco-tier mapping for multi-region blended jobs. (C) Idempotency bug in discount application where a second reconciliation pass removes a discount when encountering an unexpected tag order.

What we checked so far:
- Cross-checked postback ordering: two eco-tagged postbacks arrived nearly simultaneously; reconciler logged an out_of_order warning.
- Confirmed provisional invoice included discount line (reconciler indicated discount_applied=true).
- Confirmed finalize step did not list discount; invoice generator logs show rate-selector returned 'base-rate' for blended window.
- No postbacks were received after finalize time.

Preliminary root cause (working hypothesis): Postback reconciler deferred applying some tags due to transient DB lock; provisional invoice used a pre-backfill view and correctly applied discount, but a later finalize run re-evaluated line items using a cached rate-selector that did not yet include the eco-tag mapping for blended multi-region jobs. Race between backfill and finalize + cache staleness removed the discount line.

resolution:
Workaround applied: Issued provisional credit equal to missing eco discount (-$3,120) on 2026-03-12 and scheduled a manual re-reconcile that produced corrected invoice lines. Root cause: race between async postback ordering/backfill and invoice-generator's rate-selector cache staleness for multi-region blended jobs. Fix in progress: (1) reconciler PR to enforce deterministic ordering by event_seq and to persist pending tags before provisional invoice generation (PR 4123). (2) invoice-generator update to make eco-tier lookup resilient to cache misses; log and alert on fallback to base-rate for eligible orgs. (3) create an automated backfill tool to reconcile provisional vs finalized discrepancies and apply credits automatically.

Follow-up actions / owners:
- Billing Eng (Maya Chen): Deploy invoice-generator cache patch (ETA 2026-03-16).
- Reconciler Eng (Maya Chen): Merge ordering/idempotency PR (PR 4123) and instrument locks (ETA 2026-03-15).
- Support (Diego Ramos): Monitor GreenByte account until next cycle and validate automated backfill once available.
- SRE (Oliver Nguyen): Add postback-reorder alert on reconciler metrics.

Customer outcome: Provisional credit applied 2026-03-12, formal credit/adjustment documented on 2026-03-13. Customer accepted provisional credit and requested postmortem when changes are live.
